title: Retention Configuration
description: Configure retention policies for each entity.

changeEventRetentionPeriod.title: Change Event Retention Period (days)
changeEventRetentionPeriod.description: Enter the retention period for change event records in days (e.g., 7 for one week, 30 for one month).

testCaseResultRetentionPeriod.title: Test Case Result Retention Period (days)
testCaseResultRetentionPeriod.description: Enter the retention period for test case result records in days.

testCaseResultMinimumRetentionCount.title: Minimum Test Case Results Per Test Case
testCaseResultMinimumRetentionCount.description: Enter the minimum number of latest test case result records to retain for each test case, even when they are older than the retention period.
